label: Photorealistic cinematic
instructions: Render a live-action cinematic photograph with natural human proportions, grounded posture and physically plausible environment scale.
Keep skin unretouched with subtle pores, slight tonal variation, natural translucency, restrained specular highlights and ordinary under-eye texture.
Render individual hair strands, a few subtle flyaway hairs, believable fabric weave, garment weight and material response.
Use motivated available and practical light with slightly uneven illumination, natural shadow falloff, realistic highlight roll-off and restrained dynamic range.
Allow fine luminance noise, very subtle high-ISO grain, slight optical softness, natural focus falloff, mild highlight halation and minute lens imperfection.
Keep framing and body language candid and slightly imperfect while preserving the authored Shot composition, Character identity, wardrobe and emotional target.
prohibitions: No illustration, anime, CGI, 3D-rendered, doll-like, waxy or plastic-skin appearance.
No beauty filter, airbrushing, perfect facial symmetry, glossy advertising retouching, excessive HDR, artificial hyper-sharpness or synthetic skin glow.
No exaggerated grain, chromatic aberration, bokeh or lens effects that draw attention away from the Storyboard moment.
No impossible reflections, duplicated objects, malformed hands or physically unexplained interior weather effects.
